title: Cabinet approves Continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme
subtitle:
To promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
Targets to cover minimum 2.5 lakh beneficiaries
Approval for Credit Guarantee Corpus of Rs.4,111 crore
body_text: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme for a period of 5 years upto 31.03.2031. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) and aims to provide financial assistance to additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs in a span of five years. Since its launch in April 2016, the scheme has facilitated loans to more than 2.75 lakh Women/SC/ST entrepreneurs. Salient features of the scheme: Eligible borrowers : Women, SC and ST entrepreneurs for setting up new/green field enterprises Quantum of Support : The loan can be in the form of either Composite (Working Capital and Term Loan) or Term loan for amounts above Rs.10.00 lakh and upto Rs.1.00 crore (upto 85% of the project cost). Eligible Sectors : Manufacturing, Services, Trading and Agri allied activities. Credit Guarantee coverage : 85% of the loan amount Guarantee Fee : Standard guarantee fee of 0.50 % Impact : Credit access for women, SC and ST entrepreneurs, enabling enterprise creation and strengthening entrepreneurship across underserved communities, thereby supporting inclusive economic growth. **** MJPS
